finding: Reference values for interleukin-6 and interleukin-8 in cord blood differ between healthy term neonates born via vaginal delivery and elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: The mean interleukin-8 level was 8.1 ± 3.0 pg/mL in both vaginal and caesarean deliveries, whereas the median interleukin-6 level was 3.3 pg/mL for vaginal delivery and <2 pg/mL for caesarean section.
